profile: Arvinas is a clinical-stage biotechnology company using its PROTAC platform to develop medicines that selectively degrade disease-associated proteins. Its clinical programs address oncology, neurodegenerative disease, and immuno-oncology, including candidates targeting BCL6, LRRK2, polyQ-AR, and HPK1. Vepdegestrant, developed with Pfizer and approved as VEPPANU, is licensed to Rigel, which holds global development, manufacturing, and commercialization rights.
